steps.en: Clone over SSH and pull in the library submodules
steps.zh: 用 SSH 克隆，并拉取各个库子模块

steps.en: Copy the service-key template; blank keys still build
steps.zh: 复制服务密钥模板；密钥留空也能编译

steps.en: Build in Xcode and run it on an iPad
steps.zh: 在 Xcode 里编译，装到 iPad 上运行

steps.en: Open page stacks with one shared drawing surface on the top page
steps.zh: 打开成叠的页面，只给最上面一页挂共享绘图面

steps.en: Import a photo or PDF, then draw and cut with gestures
steps.zh: 导入照片或 PDF，再用手势书写、剪切

steps.en: Split ink onto the scraps underneath and cut scraps into new pieces
steps.zh: 把墨迹分给下面的贴图，把贴图剪成新碎片

value.en: A working iPad ink app whose scrap, scissor and page-memory code you can read and change
value.zh: 一个能跑的 iPad 手写应用，贴图、剪刀和页面内存管理的代码都能读、能改
